summary: Whether you show it or not, you swing between a strong pull toward love, beauty, and what you value and a longing for something more and a soft, porous edge, and it often shows up through other people before you own both sides. Some days you draw people in and know what you want; other days you escape, idealize, or lose your own outline. The work is holding both without picking a side.
body: Whether you show it or not, you swing between a strong pull toward love, beauty, and what you value and a longing for something more and a soft, porous edge, and it often shows up through other people before you own both sides. Some days you draw people in and know what you want; other days you escape, idealize, or lose your own outline. The work is holding both without picking a side. Real artistic gifts; guard against unrealistic expectations of people and outcomes.
gift: At your best: you draw people in and know what you want, and you imagine, feel for others, and create.
shadow: The trap: you smooth things over, or lose yourself in wanting it — or you escape, idealize, or lose your own outline.
integration: Let love and values and imagination and longing cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Real artistic gifts; guard against unrealistic expectations of people and outcomes.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you draw people in and you imagine, feel for others, work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
